slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental monitoring report (October 2016 round, 39 respondents) whose tables on electronic capture at local offices give counts of countries, not names. South Africa is named only as one of four countries with compulsory, universal registration and in the annex score bands (digitization 65-79%, planning and coordination 35-49%, infrastructure and resources 80-100%); a composite score states no event, method or office count, and no system is named.
